worldPreset.name: CyberPunk ShinobiWorld
worldPreset.description:
A high tech world of old Earth exiles that were obsessed with an ancient civilisation only refered to in the Imperial databanks as the "Rising Sun".
Though geographically and culturally inspired, the Shinobiworld is a distant reflection of it's old Earth counterpart, and is ruled by an Imperial family desperate to keep the continent under their grasp.
Cyber-technology is rampant and bio-hacking is extreme, with other Rimworld's barely able to comprehend the technological advancements of this planet.
Built using SNAFU - JapanWorld, fixed elevation, added factions, roads, some custom biomes, landmarks.
